candidates.change_summary: Delete the assignment `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` so pastBlockTime never updates after a call.
Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime = block.number;` so the stored value is the block number instead of the timestamp.
Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime += block.timestamp;` so pastBlockTime accumulates timestamps rather than storing the latest one.
Delete the assignment `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` so the stored timestamp is never updated.
Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime = block.number;` so the public getter returns the block number instead of the timestamp.
Change the payout condition from `block.number % 15 == 0` to `block.number % 15 != 0`, inverting when the transfer occurs.
Change the payout amount from `address(this).balance` to `0` so no funds are transferred out.
Change the value check from `msg.value == 10 ether` to `msg.value != 10 ether`, inverting which calls succeed.
Delete the require(msg.value == 10 ether) check so calls with any value succeed and update pastBlockTime.
Delete the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) check so multiple calls in the same block are allowed.
Delete the pastBlockTime update so pastBlockTime stays at its old value after a successful call.
Replace the lottery condition with block.number % 15 != 0 so payouts occur on blocks not divisible by 15.
Move the pastBlockTime assignment before the two require checks so pastBlockTime is updated even when a require reverts.
